reason: An AI-assisted Minecraft plugin that launches and manages the game, exposes game-control tools, and supports autonomous gameplay through visual controls and a Mineflayer LAN agent.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 Minecraft 的 AI 助手插件，可管理游戏启动、分析游戏数据，并通过视觉控制或 Mineflayer 机器人执行自主游戏操作。
summaries.en: An AI assistant plugin for Minecraft that manages game launching, analyzes game data, and enables autonomous gameplay through visual controls or a Mineflayer robot.

capabilities: Reads and writes Minecraft game files and local plugin data
Downloads Minecraft metadata and game files from external services
Authenticates with Microsoft account services and stores local account tokens
Launches and terminates Java game processes
Captures screenshots and uses simulated keyboard and mouse input
Connects to a Minecraft LAN instance to read and control game state
Sends screenshots to a hosted vision model when configured
